- type_designations: ["CMFxxx", "CMFHCxxx"] — actually "CMFxxx[1]; CMFHCx[1]" with footnote: "With xxx or x denoting the size of the measurement sensor." So type designations: "CMFxxx", "CMFHCx".
- module_designation: null or "Not applicable" — not mentioned. Omit.
- description: "Measurement transducer (Coriolis mass flow metering)..." Actually, the doc doesn't say Coriolis, but Emerson CMF series are Coriolis. Don't fabricate. Description: "A measurement transducer. See page 2 and further." Hmm, better to just include "measurement transducer" description from identification.

model_family: The cert covers CMF series sensors (CMF100y, CMF200y, CMF300y, CMF350y, CMF400y) and CMFHC series (CMFHC2y, CMFHC3y, CMFHC4y), plus electronics (MVD series, 5700).

The model matrix here: Table 2 has sensor types as columns and characteristics as rows. Table 3 similarly.

- family_name: "CMF" (CMF series)? There are two series: CMF and CMFHC. Maybe family_name null and models list all sensors.

  - environmental_classes: "M3 / E3 / H3"
  - ambient_temperature_range: {value: {min: -40, max: 55}, unit_symbol: "°C"}
  - intended_for_measurement: "Oil and oil products, alcohol, chemicals, potable liquids, cryogenic liquids"

- model_level:

- temperature_range_liquid_for_mass_measurement: class 0.3 and 0.5: -10...+250 °C; class 1.5: -200...+50 °C
- temperature_range_liquid_for_density_and_volume_measurement: -10...+150 °C (applies to all classes; the 1.5 cell is empty but colspan 2 for 0.3/0.5 covers first two columns, and empty for 1.5 — hmm. Actually the table:

| Temperature range liquid for mass measurement | colspan=2: -10 °C … +250 °C | -200 °C … +50 °C |
| Temperature range liquid for density and volume measurement | colspan=2: -10 °C … +150 °C | (empty) |

So density/volume range -10 to +150 applies to classes 0.3 and 0.5; the 1.5 cell is empty. Hmm, could mean it's the same -200...+50 as mass? Not stated. Don't fabricate — record as config_level by accuracy_class with conditions "0.3; 0.5" and note the 1.5 empty.

I'll use config_level for these:
- attribute: temperature_range_liquid_for_mass_measurement, axis: accuracy_class, values: [{condition: "0.3", value: {min:-10,max:250}, unit: "°C"}, {condition: "0.5", ...}, {condition: "1.5", value: {min:-200,max:50}, unit: "°C"}]

I'll split into separate conditions for clarity.

   - {role: "electronics", type_designations: ["5700 electronics"], alternatives: "OR"}
   Or combine: {role: "electronics", type_designations: ["MVD series", "5700"], alternatives: "OR"}.
